title: What Is Shame? A Psychologist Explains Its Hidden Power

sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你们除了用时间换取金钱，还能赚到更多的钱呢？

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的福利。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时都在。

sentences.en: Have you ever felt like you were the problem?
sentences.zh: 你是否曾觉得自己才是那个问题所在？

sentences.en: Not just that you made a mistake, but that you were fundamentally flawed.
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是犯了错，而是觉得自己从根本上就有缺陷。

sentences.en: That sinking feeling, the urge to hide, that voice in your head saying, if people really knew me, they'd walk away.
sentences.zh: 那种沉重下坠的感觉，想要躲藏的冲动，脑海中那个声音在说：“如果人们真的了解我，他们会离开的。”

sentences.en: That's shame, and it runs deeper than fear, guilt, or embarrassment.
sentences.zh: 那就是羞耻感，它比恐惧、内疚或尴尬扎根得更深。

sentences.en: It can shape our sense of self, our relationships, and even our careers.
sentences.zh: 它能塑造我们的自我认知、人际关系，甚至我们的职业生涯。

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne, a qualified clinical psychologist, and if any of that resonated, you're in the right place.
sentences.zh: 我是玛丽安博士，一名合格的临床心理学家，如果这些话触动了你，那么你来对地方了。

sentences.zh: 让我们来聊聊羞耻感，请点赞并订阅以获取更多内容。

sentences.en: So shame can show up in a variety of ways and keep us from fulfilling what might be our full potential.
sentences.zh: 羞耻感会以各种各样的方式表现出来，阻碍我们发挥出全部的潜能。

sentences.en: You might be watching this because you yourself are struggling with shame,
sentences.zh: 你可能正在看这个视频，因为你自己正饱受羞耻感的困扰，

sentences.en: or because someone that you care about is, or maybe even someone that you're working with clinically might be too.
sentences.zh: 或者是因为你在乎的人正在经历这一切，又或者你在临床工作中接触的某人也正经历着这些。

sentences.en: And in today's episode, we're going to be looking at what shame is, how it shows up in our lives, and what influence it can have on ourselves and those around us too.
sentences.zh: 在今天的节目中，我们将探讨什么是羞耻感，它在我们的生活中是如何表现的，以及它对我们自身和周围的人会产生什么样的影响。

sentences.en: What is shame?
sentences.zh: 什么是羞耻感？

sentences.en: Shame is an intense emotion that makes us feel like there's something wrong with us at our very core.
sentences.zh: 羞耻感是一种强烈的情绪，它让我们觉得自己在核心本质上出了问题。

sentences.en: Unlike guilt, which is about feeling bad for something we've done, shame is about feeling bad for who we are.
sentences.zh: 内疚感是对我们做过的事情感到难过，而羞耻感与内疚感不同，它是对自己这个人感到难过。

sentences.en: It tells us we're unworthy, unlovable, or flawed.
sentences.zh: 它告诉我们，我们是不配的、不讨人喜欢的，或者是有缺陷的。

sentences.en: There can be a really nice way of thinking about what shame is and how to separate it from guilt.
sentences.zh: 有一种非常棒的方法可以用来思考什么是羞耻感，以及如何将它与内疚感区分开来。

sentences.en: So shame is like a focus on the self.
sentences.zh: 羞耻感就像是将焦点集中在自我本身。

sentences.en: So that's like, I am bad.
sentences.zh: 也就是“我很糟糕”。

sentences.en: Whereas guilt will focus on behaviour, like I did something bad.
sentences.zh: 而内疚感则关注行为，比如“我做了一件坏事”。

sentences.en: Shame, importantly, is often invisible.
sentences.zh: 重要的是，羞耻感往往是无形的。

sentences.en: People might not even be able to name it or kind of get a sense of it.
sentences.zh: 人们甚至可能无法说出它的名字，或者对其没有什么概念。

sentences.en: But that doesn't mean that its effects can't still be felt really deeply.
sentences.zh: 但这并不意味着它的影响不能被深深地感受到。

sentences.en: Brené Brown calls shame the intensely painful feeling or experience of believing that we are flawed and therefore unworthy of love and belonging.
sentences.zh: 布琳·布朗（Brené Brown）将羞耻感称之为一种强烈痛苦的感觉或体验，它让我们坚信自己是有缺陷的，因此不配得到爱与归属感。

sentences.en: So let's take a look, where does shame come from?
sentences.zh: 那么让我们来看看，羞耻感是从哪里来的？

sentences.en: It can often develop from childhood.
sentences.zh: 它通常在童年时期形成。

sentences.en: It's about the way that we've been reared and those experiences that we've had when we've done certain things in our lives.
sentences.zh: 它与我们的养育方式有关，以及我们在生活中做某些事情时所经历的那些经历。

sentences.en: They might result from things such as
sentences.zh: 它们可能源于以下因素：

sentences.en: Critical or shaming parental style
sentences.zh: 批判性或带有羞辱性质的父母教养方式

sentences.en: Experiences of neglect or abuse
sentences.zh: 遭受忽视或虐待的经历

sentences.en: Having been bullied, rejected, or isolated
sentences.zh: 曾遭受霸凌、排挤或孤立

sentences.en: Messages from school, religion, or society about what is acceptable and what is not
sentences.zh: 来自学校、宗教或社会关于什么是可接受的、什么不是的讯息

sentences.en: Experiences of racism, homophobia, ableism, or other marginalisation
sentences.zh: 遭受种族主义、恐同症、对残疾人的歧视或其他边缘化对待的经历

sentences.en: Even as adults, like we can be really well-meaning but accidentally shame people with the language choices that we use.
sentences.zh: 即使作为成年人，我们可能也是出于好意，但却会因为我们所使用的语言选择而无意中羞辱了别人。

sentences.en: That might look like You should be ashamed of yourself
sentences.zh: 那可能表现为：你真该感到羞耻

sentences.en: Don't be silly
sentences.zh: 别傻了

sentences.en: Stop crying you're being a baby
sentences.zh: 别哭了，你像个小宝宝一样

sentences.en: Shame can also develop in later life
sentences.zh: 羞耻感也可能在晚年生活中发展出来

sentences.en: Especially after trauma, rejection, failure, or having been humiliated.
sentences.zh: 特别是在经历了创伤、拒绝、失败或受到羞辱之后。

sentences.en: When I was on LinkedIn the other day I saw a really powerful post
sentences.zh: 前几天我在领英（LinkedIn）上看到一篇非常有力量的帖子

sentences.en: Where someone had been talking about their experiences on graduation And where they had worn an outfit that they wanted to feel really excited and proud about
sentences.zh: 里面有人谈到他们在毕业典礼上的经历，当时他们穿了一套让他们感到非常兴奋和骄傲的衣服

sentences.en: So they'd worn a dress, probably quite similar to the dress I'm wearing now With their arms out and showing their legs
sentences.zh: 所以他们穿了一条裙子，大概和我现在穿的这条裙子差不多，双手张开，露出了双腿

sentences.en: And somebody had said to them, well don't you feel ashamed having your body out like that?
sentences.zh: 然后有人对他们说：“把身体露成这样，难道你不觉得羞耻吗？”

sentences.en: And that had made her think
sentences.zh: 这让她开始思考

sentences.en: Actually, no, I don't You know, this is who I am
sentences.zh: 其实，我不觉得，你知道的，这就是我

sentences.en: This is my authentic self And it made her think about whether she still wanted to be
sentences.zh: 这就是最真实的我，这让她开始思考自己是否还想继续

sentences.en: Part of the religion that she had been raised in So that gives a really nice flavour
sentences.zh: 留在她从小长大的那个宗教里，所以这给我们提供了一个非常好的例子

sentences.en: A really nice example Of how shame
sentences.zh: 一个非常好的切入点，展示了羞耻感

sentences.en: Can be kind of layered upon us And then reinforced over time
sentences.zh: 是如何被一层一层叠加在我们身上，然后在时间的推移中被周围的人不断强化的

sentences.en: By the people around us But of course we get choices
sentences.zh: 但当然，当我们长大成人后，我们拥有了选择权

sentences.en: Once we get to be grown-ups We can choose to do something differently And more of that will be coming up in episode 2
sentences.zh: 我们可以选择做一些不同的事情，关于如何应对羞耻感，更多内容将在第二集中揭晓

sentences.en: About what to do about shame
sentences.zh: 关于如何处理羞耻感

sentences.en: Today we're taking a really deep dive And unpacking what it is So how does shame affect us?
sentences.zh: 今天我们将进行深入探讨，剖析它究竟是什么，那么羞耻感是如何影响我们的呢？

sentences.en: Oh, shame can be tricky It can be the master of disguise
sentences.zh: 哦，羞耻感可能很狡猾，它是伪装大师

sentences.en: And it can show up in so many ways In the driver's seat And in control I thought it might be really nice To look at a couple of case studies So that we can really illuminate
sentences.zh: 它可以以各种各样的方式出现，占据主导地位并掌控一切，我觉得看几个案例研究可能会非常棒，这样我们就能真正阐明

sentences.en: How and why shame shows up for people
sentences.zh: 羞耻感是如何以及为什么会在人们身上出现的

sentences.en: Firstly, let's meet James
sentences.zh: 首先，让我们认识一下詹姆斯（James）

sentences.en: James is a 36-year-old teacher And he recently found out That his long-term partner
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯是一位36岁的老师，他最近发现他长期交往的伴侣

sentences.en: Had cheated on him
sentences.zh: 背叛了他

sentences.en: Rationally, he knew that it wasn't his fault But the shame hit hard
sentences.zh: 从理性上讲，他知道这不是他的错，但羞耻感却沉重地袭来

sentences.en: His internal thoughts were those like I must be boring
sentences.zh: 他的内心独白是这样的：“我一定很无趣”

sentences.en: I'm not enough
sentences.zh: “我还不够好”

sentences.en: Everyone's going to think I'm pathetic
sentences.zh: “每个人都会觉得我很可悲”

sentences.en: Maybe I'm not good enough in bed He has been withdrawing from his friends
sentences.zh: “也许我在床上表现得不够好”他一直在疏远朋友

sentences.en: Keeping himself busy at work And telling himself to get over it
sentences.zh: 用工作填满自己的时间，并告诉自己要振作起来

sentences.en: Stop being stupid
sentences.zh: “别犯傻了”

sentences.en: Man up
sentences.zh: “拿出点男子气概来”

sentences.en: All those kind of things But the shame stays under the surface
sentences.zh: 所有这些诸如此类的话，但羞耻感依然潜伏在表面之下

sentences.en: Unspoken and feels so heavy
sentences.zh: 难以言说，却又如此沉重

sentences.zh: 现在让我们来看看阿米娜（Amina）

sentences.en: Amina is an assistant psychologist
sentences.zh: 阿米娜是一名助理心理学家

sentences.en: Who applied for training But didn't get in this year
sentences.zh: 她申请了培训项目，但今年没有被录取

sentences.en: Although she has had excellent feedback
sentences.zh: 尽管多年来她一直从主管那里得到极佳的反馈

sentences.en: From her supervisors over the years And she rationally knows
sentences.zh: 而且她理智上也知道

sentences.en: How competitive this process is She feels crushed And inside her thoughts are spiralling
sentences.zh: 这个过程竞争有多么激烈，但她还是感到崩溃，内心思绪万千

sentences.en: I'm not good enough I should have done better

sentences.en: Everyone else is progressing And I'm being left behind
sentences.zh: “其他所有人都在前进，而我却被抛在了后面”

sentences.en: Everyone will know that I'm not good enough She starts avoiding professional spaces online She doesn't tell her friends what's happening She feels alone and ashamed
sentences.zh: “所有人都知道我不够好”她开始在网上逃避职业圈子，她没有把发生的事情告诉朋友，她感到孤独且羞愧

sentences.en: This isn't guilt
sentences.zh: 这并不是内疚

sentences.en: Amina didn't do anything wrong But she feels like she is wrong
sentences.zh: 阿米娜没有做错任何事，但她觉得自己整个人都是错的

sentences.en: Like her worth is in question So why does shame matter?
sentences.zh: 就像她的价值受到了质疑，那么为什么羞耻感如此重要呢？

sentences.en: So shame isn't just an emotional experience It can affect all aspects of our life
sentences.zh: 所以羞耻感不仅仅是一种情绪体验，它会影响我们生活的方方面面

sentences.en: Including our behaviour
sentences.zh: 包括我们的行为

sentences.en: Our relationships And of course our mental health It can be linked to depression
sentences.zh: 我们的人际关系，当然还有我们的心理健康，它可能与抑郁症有关

sentences.en: Anxiety
sentences.zh: 焦虑

sentences.en: PTSD
sentences.zh: 创伤后应激障碍（PTSD）

sentences.en: Disordered eating And low self-esteem In career situations It can cause paralysis
sentences.zh: 饮食失调以及低自尊，在职业生涯中，它可能会导致瘫痪状态

sentences.en: Around applying for roles or courses

sentences.en: Putting ourselves forward

sentences.en: Avoidance of feedback And of course burnout
sentences.zh: 逃避反馈，当然还有过度工作导致的

sentences.en: From overworking To prove our worth
sentences.zh: 职业倦怠，试图以此证明自己的价值

sentences.en: Shame can affect everyone And it can hold us back It can make us feel like We are missing the opportunities
sentences.zh: 羞耻感会影响每一个人，它会拖住我们的后腿，让我们觉得

sentences.en: Like they're passing us by Because we think we're not good enough for them Or that we're somehow internally flawed
sentences.zh: 机会正在从我们身边溜走，因为我们觉得自己配不上它们，或者觉得自己在内部某个地方有缺陷

sentences.en: The importance of naming shame
sentences.zh: 给羞耻感命名的重要性

sentences.en: Shame is powerful But it does lose its power When we speak about it
sentences.zh: 羞耻感很有力量，但当我们把它说出来时，它就会失去力量

sentences.zh: 这一集就是对你的邀请，去识别你的羞耻感

sentences.zh: 甚至在我刚开始着手写《悲伤集体》那本书时
